endorsements.name: Pau Oliva Fora
endorsements.label: Defeating SEAndroid
endorsements.description: Security Enhancements for Android (SEAndroid) enables the use of SELinux in Android in order to limit the damage that can be done by malicious apps, trying to make exploitation harder. Some OEMs are trying hard to implement extra mitigations in their devices, especially those aiming to reach the enterprise market. We will present some issues that are found in devices currently implementing SEAndroid, and demonstrate how vendors FAIL in properly implementing SEAndroid protection.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 21

evidence-links.title: DEF CON 21 - Pau Oliva Fora - Defeating SEAndroid

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
